marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

## Summary

Completed bead **sase-xy.5.2** (repository-resolution phase of the pager-target-integrity epic):

- **sase-core (Rust):** new `artifact_ref/repository_resolution.rs` module with `resolve_document_source_target`, implementing repository-identity-aware resolution — caller-attached checkouts, explicit/scoped repository inventory, other checkouts of the same repo, and a bounded (20k-entry) suffix search for drifted paths. New wire types (`ArtifactRefDocumentOwnerWire`, `ArtifactRefTargetResolutionWire`/`CandidateWire`/`FailureCategoryWire`) carry provenance, candidate evidence, failure category, and retryability instead of collapsing to `None`. 10 new Rust unit tests cover the fixture scenarios from the plan (owning-repo resolution, ambiguous linked repos, deleted-producer-workspace fallback, absent checkout, drift, explicit scoping). Added the PyO3 binding plus an extended binding round-trip test.
- **sase (Python):** thin adapter (`resolve_document_source_target`) and models (`ArtifactRefDocumentOwner`, `ArtifactRefTargetResolution`, `ArtifactRefTargetCandidate`) exposed through the `artifact_refs` facade, with 4 focused tests.
- **Verification:** sase-core's `scripts/check.sh all` (fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, full workspace test) passed; rebuilt the `sase_core_rs` extension via `just rust-install`; sase's `just check` passed (all lint gates, scoped tests escalated to full suite, 109/109 `tests/artifact_refs/` passing).
- Filed one `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` note on the bead: repository-scoped source-path resolution has no glob/permission filter policy yet (the `DeniedFiltered` category is currently unreachable).

Bead closed, epic-symbol guard clean, and the final commit declaration was accepted for both the `sase` and `sase-core` repos.
